entries.title: Tablet stability and Focus Realm mobile polish
entries.summary: Stabilized Quick Capture on touch devices, made Deep Dive strictly double-activation for pointer users, and replaced the forced tablet/mobile radial layout with a roomy scrollable constellation.
changes: Quick Capture opens immediately without waiting for graph data
Touch devices no longer autofocus the title field and trigger viewport/keyboard flicker
Heavy dialog backdrop blur is disabled on coarse-pointer devices
Single click only selects; double-click or double-tap enters Deep Dive
Nested Focus Realm navigation also uses double activation
Tablet/mobile Focus Realm uses a spacious scrollable grid and keeps all cards inside the viewport
Focus Realm detail panel is restored and spaced for small screens
Focus Realm header now exposes menu, Quick Capture and fullscreen actions
Regular inspector auto-closes when entering Focus Realm

entries.title: Interaction hotfix and gesture model
entries.summary: Reworked canvas input around explicit Navigate and Edit modes, fixed Deep Dive double activation, desktop sidebar collapse, and touch pinch zoom.
changes: Navigate mode is the safe default and prevents accidental node dragging
Edit mode explicitly enables node layout dragging
Two-finger pinch zoom on tablet and mobile
Double-click and double-tap detection by stable node ID
Desktop menu now collapses and restores the sidebar
Pan starting on a node no longer causes false node activation
H and V keyboard shortcuts switch interaction modes

entries.title: Responsive workspace, local authoring and public technical communication
entries.summary: Made the knowledge system practical across desktop, tablet and mobile while adding a safe daily capture workflow and durable architecture/history pages.
changes: Sidebar drawer and tablet/mobile layouts
Fullscreen canvas with native API and CSS fallback
Mobile bottom-sheet inspector
Local-first Quick Capture and Knowledge Inbox CRUD
JSON export and canonical proposal copy
System Design Overview page
Data-driven project changelog page

entries.title: Focus Realm deep-dive projection
entries.summary: Introduced an immersive radial space that focuses on one node, its children and semantic neighbors with breadcrumb and back navigation.
changes: Double-click deep dive
Radial scoped layout
Breadcrumb hierarchy
Reduced-motion support

entries.title: Canvas visual polish
entries.summary: Improved text rendering and made the canvas background configurable with a quieter default.
changes: Plain default background
Soft grid, dots and slate modes
Zoom guard
Pixel snapping

Fresher to Lead Backend profile
